column1: # W4 scope: the policy blocks that decide whether the contact map can draw.
# file <TAB> anchor <TAB> why this block serves the site
# The ANCHOR is a literal line fragment that opens the policy block. It is
# how this file names a block without naming a line number - numbers drift
# with every edit above them, and a scan that follows a drifted number
# A missing file or a missing anchor is an ABORT, not a pass: a renamed
# constant would otherwise leave this suite measuring nothing and printing
# green, which is the failure this project has paid for more than once.
# NOT IN SCOPE, and deliberately: the `const CSP = [` block in
# web.native.mjs. That is the policy for the portal and the console, which
# show no map and have no business reaching a tile server. Widening it to
# satisfy this suite would hand the two origins that carry the whole API a
# permission they have no use for.
